verdicts: Fair test: the world is exactly linear and learnable from the training points (least squares masters every task in and out of range in every world) and the untrained X1.6 learner holds some structure after 10 steps
LSQ min share in/out 1.00/1.00; FRESH10 bits 0.812
The tanh network trained to convergence maps the linear world IN RANGE (median share of tasks mastered >= hi)
It does NOT map it OUT OF RANGE (sd 3 inputs): median share mastered < lo (it fits the cloud, not the line)
The same network without tanh maps it in AND out of range (both medians >= hi): the gap is the activation, not the optimizer
The X1.6 regime (10 steps) does not map even rung 0 (META10 median share in < lo), but meta-training helps (META10 - FRESH10 bits held, paired range above 0)
Depth of the hidden LINEAR rule does not matter to the converged tanh network: share mastered in range at depth 5 minus depth 1, median within tol
